title: Python streaming chat orchestration hooks and soft-ack patterns
creator: Sofia Ramos
description:
Problem: Consumers of the Python SDK ask for a simpler, more resilient streaming chat surface that: 1) makes it easy to implement soft acknowledgements and idempotent handlers for downstream sinks, 2) emits structured telemetry hooks for token-level and event-level latency/cost breakdowns, and 3) supports lightweight resumability without forcing full checkpoint serialization semantics.

Goal: Design and implement an ergonomic facade on top of the existing streaming primitives that provides: a small set of lifecycle hooks (on_chunk, on_event, on_ack, on_checkpoint), an opt-in soft-ack contract to indicate safe-to-drop vs commit-required fragments, and telemetry callback points that surface cost/latency metrics and backpressure signals. The API must be backwards-compatible with the current iterator/callback surfaces and include cookbook examples for common consumer patterns (fanout to DB, webhook sink, analytics pipeline).
acceptance_criteria: New compact facade exported as `StreamingChatFacade` in sdk.python.streaming module
Facade exposes hooks: on_chunk, on_event, on_ack, on_checkpoint and a resume() helper
Soft-ack contract implemented: handler can return {"ack": "soft"}|{"ack": "commit"}|{"ack": "drop"}
Telemetry callbacks invoked with token_count, latency_ms, model_id, route, and backpressure_reason
End-to-end example added to docs showing DB sink with idempotent dedupe and graceful resume
Unit + integration tests covering resume after N chunks, duplicate replay, and soft-ack semantics
Performance regression < 3% tail latency for typical 32-token streams in existing CI clusters
implementation_notes: Introduce StreamingChatFacade wrapper that can wrap existing event iterator or SSE stream
Expose `ack_policy` enum: soft|commit|drop default soft to minimize data loss risk
Implement lightweight checkpoint format: last_event_id + k/v digest (string) so customers can store small cursor blobs
Telemetry hook signature: telemetry(event_type, meta:dict, metrics:dict) where meta/metrics are serialized dicts (stringified in logs). For JSON-only ticket, include sample payloads in PR description

Retry semantics: facade should surface a `retry_hint` when downstream sinks return transient errors so retry orchestration can be delegated to caller or to an optional helper `backpressure_retry_loop()`
Compatibility: keep existing iterator semantics for clients that prefer raw stream; facade is opt-in
